entry.title: Daegaya, 562: The Year the Last Gaya Closed

entry.title: Gwansanseong, 554: Where an Alliance Ended

entry.title: Keeping Direct Command From Becoming a Cheat: Balancing It by Computer

entry.title: Four Kingdoms, Four Colors, Still Distinct at Night

entry.title: A Three Kingdoms Land Grab for Your Phone
entry.summary: Why we're building Iltonggi, a Three Kingdoms land-grab game for your phone: 5-10 minute rounds, autosave, a short first game, and no daily log-in pressure.
